verification: cd cli && grep -q 'X main.commit={{ .FullCommit }}' .goreleaser.yaml && go test ./internal/cmd/ -run TestVersionCommitFlagPrintsBareValue

verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ -run TestVersionDefaultOutputStaysSingleLineForTheInstallers && cd .. && bats tests/install-dotf.bats
